data.name: Surin
data.gender_notes: Surin is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Surin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'Sun'. Surin is a name that represents the power of the sun, and is associated with victory, strength, and the ability to overcome challenges. The name Surin carries the meaning “Sun, victory, strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Tamil. Parents who choose Surin usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, victory, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Surin is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology. It is believed that the god Surya, who represents the sun, is the source of all life and energy. By bearing this name, one is connected to the divine power and energy of the sun, and is able to draw strength and inspiration from it.
data.etymology: Surin belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, victory, strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Surin total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
